The sea level stand at 0.90 ± 0.20 m bmsl was evidenced by the beachrock generations found on Keos (0.65

evidence for the dating of this sea level, only that arising from the rockfill on the Lageri coast (N Paros), which
dates it to after the Venetian period and during the Ottoman rule of Cyclades. The change to the next sea level
stand could be linked to the strong seismic sequence that struck Kythnos Island between 29.4.1891 and 11.5.1891
(Figure 15b).
